name: looser-shots
note: Top bots fire far more freely than we do: of about 1,500 shots by StuartSutcliffe and Shelbot4 in the replay corpus only one in five is guaranteed, and in their positions matrix-5 takes about 40% of the shots they take. This arm removes the cost of firing and values each turn 70% against a plain opponent that stands still 70% of the time (prior_weight, prior_hold) instead of only against a perfect dodger. In StuartSutcliffe's positions it takes 58% of his shots. Needs a release at or after the commit that adds prior_weight. Every opponent, balanced by opponent, map and seat.
